title: CLI project-resolution failure is typed and actionable: when .engram-project cannot be read the receipt explains cwd-based project selection, names the required directory, and offers the recovery command; never silently selects or creates a project
outcome: CLI project-resolution failure is typed and actionable: when .engram-project cannot be read the receipt explains cwd-based project selection, names the required directory, and offers the recovery command; never silently selects or creates a project
acceptance: running any word from a directory without a readable .engram-project prints a typed refusal with the reason, the directory that was searched, the fact that project selection is cwd-based, and a next command (cd to the project directory or the explicit project flag), on CLI text and --json; no project is selected or created implicitly

completion.summary: Delivered typed actionable CLI project-selection refusal, Unicode-safe text with exact JSON, deterministic cwd fallback, carried gate-family query narrowing, and aligned docs/agent skill; all gates and both review closures accepted, landed and installed.
